limitations: The README VSC command references a configuration absent from the pinned repository. This guide uses the checked-in GSD example instead and does not claim VSC results.
The Docker tags are not image-digest pinned by the README; this code revision alone does not freeze algorithm containers.
Ground-truth network availability and matching input/configuration paths are prerequisites; no data-download command is invented.
The inspected instructions do not establish a minimum RAM/VRAM requirement, wall-clock runtime or monetary cost; none is inferred.
outputs: Ranked edges under outputs/example_run_GSD/GSD/<run_id>/<algorithm_id>/rankedEdges.csv, using output_settings in the supplied config.
AUPRC and AUROC plot files under ./plots in PDF and PNG formats.
prerequisites: Git, conda and a functioning Docker installation; the repository executes supported algorithms in containers.
The supplied config-files/config.yaml expects GSD expression, pseudotime and ground-truth files under inputs/example/GSD. Verify the local data layout before running.

steps.explanation: Repository checkout wrapper: the detached revision selects the exact official source inspected for this guide.
steps.shell:
git clone https://github.com/Murali-group/Beeline.git
cd Beeline
git checkout --detach 37464085eb8a95d6cc6a3d3a3c649d36db6052ed
steps.title: Check out the reviewed repository

steps.explanation: These setup commands use the official default image-pull behavior. Conda must already be initialized in the shell; the README illustrates a Miniconda-specific initialization path.
steps.shell:
bash utils/setupAnacondaVENV.sh
bash utils/initialize.sh
conda activate BEELINE
steps.title: Set up the environment and algorithm images

steps.explanation: This executes the algorithms and datasets enabled by the YAML file. The README points to a missing VSC file; this guide explicitly substitutes the supplied GSD example config, so it is a different example dataset.
steps.title: Run the configured algorithms

steps.explanation: The flags are selected from the official tables: evaluator -a computes AUPRC/AUROC; plotter -a and -r produce their corresponding figures. The README points to a missing VSC file; this guide explicitly substitutes the supplied GSD example config, so it is a different example dataset.
steps.shell:
python BLEvaluator.py -c config-files/config.yaml -a
python BLPlotter.py -c config-files/config.yaml -o ./plots -a -r
steps.title: Evaluate and plot ROC/precision-recall performance

summary: Run and evaluate the supplied BEELINE GSD example configuration, then generate AUPRC/AUROC plots.
